description: Context trim. Any text in, URL-encoded as the text query parameter (up to 12,000 bytes), a leaner rendering out: line endings normalized, trailing whitespace stripped, blank runs collapsed, adjacent duplicate lines dropped, an optional budget query parameter trimming to a character count at a paragraph, sentence, or word boundary, every change counted. Price: $0.02 per call, paid in USDC on Base mainnet over x402; an unpaid call answers HTTP 402 with the exact machine-readable payment terms.

budget.description: Optional character budget, an integer between 200 and 12,000 (default 2,000).

text.description: The text to trim (up to 12,000 bytes).

name: context-trim
